title: crocanthemum chihuahuense
intro: Crocanthemum chihuahuense, commonly known as Mexican daisy, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and the southwestern United States. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Crocanthemum chihuahuense include its ability to act as an antiseptic and antispasmodic, which can help to calm the nervous system and relieve muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
